#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

namespace IO {
    template<typename T>
    inline int Read(T &n) {
        T k=0, f=1; char c=getchar();
        while (c<'0' || c>'9') { if (c == '-') f=-1; c=getchar(); }
        while (c>='0' && c<='9') { k=(k<<3)+(k<<1)+(c-'0'); c=getchar(); }
        n = k*f; return 0;
    }
    template<typename T>
    inline void Write(T x) {
        if (x < 0) { putchar('-'); x=-x; }
        if (x > 9) Write(x/10);
        putchar(x%10+'0');
    }
    template<typename T, typename ...Y>
    inline int Read(T &x, Y&... y) { return Read(x) | Read(y...); }
}

#define LL long long
#define REP(i, a, b) for(LL i=(a); i<=(b); ++i)
#define RREP(i, a, b) for(LL i=(a); i>=(b); --i)
const LL MOD1 = 998244353, MOD2 = 1000000007;
LL total, n, cnt1, prefix[7];
vector<LL> values[7];

inline void precompute(LL level, LL base) {
    if (level == 7) return;
    values[level].push_back((cnt1 - base + MOD1) % MOD1);
    prefix[level] = (prefix[level] + (cnt1 - base + MOD1) % MOD1) % MOD2;
    cnt1++;
    REP(i, 0, 9) precompute(level+1, base*10 + i);
}

inline bool valid(LL x) {
    const LL LIMIT = 1000000;
    return x * LIMIT + 999999 <= n && x * LIMIT * 10 > n;
}

LL cnt2;
LL powers[7] = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000};

inline void enumerate(LL level, LL current) {
    if (current > n) return;
    if (valid(current)) {
        REP(i, 0, 6) {
            LL diff = (cnt2 + 1 - (current * powers[i])) % MOD1;
            if (diff < 0) diff += MOD1;
            LL idx = lower_bound(values[i].begin(), values[i].end(), MOD1 - diff) - values[i].begin();
            total = (total + prefix[i] + diff * (LL)values[i].size() - MOD1 * (LL)(values[i].size() - idx)) % MOD2;
        }
        cnt2 += cnt1;
    } else {
        cnt2++;
        LL term = (cnt2 - current) % MOD1;
        if (term < 0) term += MOD1;
        total = (total + term) % MOD2;
        REP(i, !level, 9) enumerate(level+1, current*10 + i);
    }
}

int main() {
    IO::Read(n);
    precompute(0, 0);
    REP(i, 0, 6) sort(values[i].begin(), values[i].end());
    cnt2 = -1;
    enumerate(0, 0);
    IO::Write(total);
}
